prompt: Why do you hold the canary longer on Fridays?
answer: Weekend traffic shifts the error baseline and a short canary hides regressions.
name: Why: Why do you hold the canary longer on Fridays?
why_answer: Weekend traffic shifts the error baseline and a short canary hides regressions.
